effect.name: GM Signal Tear
effect.desc: Broadcast-style horizontal sync tears with displaced duplicates, dropout bands and color carrier delay.
effect.shader: float h(float x){return fract(sin(x*127.1)*43758.5453);}void main(){vec2 uv=acScreenNorm,sz=max(inputImg.size,vec2(1.0));float frame=floor(acTime*15.0+evolution),row=floor(uv.y*tearCount),rnd=h(row+frame),phase=fract(uv.y*tearCount);float band=1.0-smoothstep(bandWidth,bandWidth*2.0,abs(phase-rnd));float shift=(rnd-.5)*distancePx/sz.x*band;vec2 p=clamp(uv+vec2(shift,0),0.0,1.0);vec4 src=texture2DCv(inputImg.texture,uv),base=texture2DCv(inputImg.texture,p);vec2 cd=vec2(carrierDelayPx/sz.x*band,0);base.r=texture2DCv(inputImg.texture,clamp(p+cd,0.0,1.0)).r;base.b=texture2DCv(inputImg.texture,clamp(p-cd,0.0,1.0)).b;base.rgb*=1.0-dropout*band*step(.72,rnd);gl_FragColor=mix(src,base,mixAmount*band);}
